title: BmB Excessive Infractions

replies.author: Javipepe
replies.body:
The player has got 17 non-appealed infractions. Our "ban guide" regarding "Excessive Infractions" is like following:

"  Excessive infractions (2 pages) - Temporary ban | 20 - 25 days 
       Excessive infractions (2 or more after first "excessive infractions" punishment) - Permanent ban "

The player will not be punished until he gathers enough non-appealed infractions as for to fill 2 pages.  Please fill a report again if that happens.

Regards,

javipepe - Avicus Network Moderator and Referee
